description: This file defines the SessionsService class which manages review session records. It includes methods for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting sessions, utilizing SQL queries with parameterized inputs.

classes.name: SessionsService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to manage review sessions, including listing with filters, retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of session records in the database.

methods.name: list({ limit, offset, sortBy, sortDir, status, q })
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of review sessions from the database based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single review session by its unique identifier; throws NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: create(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new review session record with validation on the status field.

methods.name: update(id, payload)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing review session, validating the status and ensuring updatable fields are provided.

methods.name: remove(id)
methods.description: Deletes a review session by ID, throwing NotFoundError if the session does not exist.

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^  async list({ limit, offset, sortBy, sortDir, status, q }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ limit, offset, sortBy, sortDir, status, q })
